title: Important: please read
lead: LearningLinks is only a connection website.
full: We do not carry out background checks on teachers, schools or families, and we do not verify identity, credentials, licences or work permits. Everyone is responsible for completing all checks and for following all government laws, policies and procedures that apply to them.
short: We only connect people. We do not run background checks on anyone. Please complete all checks and follow all government policies and procedures yourself.
